altTitles.es-la: Un ordinario club de música ligera

description.en:
With a passion for richly textured Japanese rock, first-year high school student Chihiro Hatono steps into the world of the light music club, new guitar in tow. But what awaits her behind those doors...?
___
**Award:** Won the 10th Next Manga Awards Web Category (2024).

**Official English Volumes:** [Seven Seas](https://sevenseasentertainment.com/series/girl-meets-rock/)
description.ja: ちょっと渋めの邦ロックを愛する新高校1年生・鳩野ちひろは、初心者ながらも憧れのギターを手に入れ、念願の軽音部に入部する。個性豊かな部員たちに困惑しつつも、バンドを結成することになるが――！？
description.es-la: Chihiro Hatono, estudiante de primer año de preparatoria y apasionada por el rock japonés se adentra en el mundo del club de música ligera con una nueva guitarra a cuestas. Pero, ¿qué le espera tras esas puertas...? ¡Un drama sobre juventud sin filtros y ambición musical toma el escenario!
description.pt-br: Com uma paixão pelo rock japonês ricamente texturizado, a estudante do primeiro ano do ensino médio Chihiro Hatono entra no mundo do clube de música leve, com uma nova guitarra em mãos. Mas o que a espera atrás daquelas portas...? Um drama de juventude não filtrada e ambição musical sobe ao palco!

description.en:
Noh Gajang is a strong, dedicated, and humble man, with much respect for the martial arts. But after the death of his lovely wife, this muscle-for-hire just wants an easy job that allows him to be a good father to his three little babies. He’s even happy to pull guard duty and fend off amateur fighters if it means he can return home safely each night. 

But when a creepy cult starts stealing children from the city, Gajang must step up to the challenge and discover his true warrior potential.

하늘의 뜻을 아니, 그 누가 아비父에 견주리오! 
고아로 떠돌다 운 좋게 스승을 만나 특급 해결사로 이름을 날리던 노가장.
사랑하는 여인을 만나 이름대로 가장家長이 된다는 기쁨도 잠시, 하루아침에 핏덩이 세쌍둥이를 홀로 키워야 하는 신세가 되었다. 아비는 그 어떤 경우라도 제 새끼의 입에 먹을 걸 넣어 줘야 하는 존재인 법! 노가장은 위험천만한 낭인 생활을 때려치우고 천룡회 갑급 무사가 되어  자식새끼들 잘 먹이고 입히고자 한다. 하지만 억지로 나간 출장 임무는 목숨이 위험하기만 하고 그 사이 사방에선 그의 아이들을 눈독 들이기 시작하는데…… 기다려라, 내 새끼들아! 여기 아비가 간다!

description.pt:
Noh Ga Jang teve a vida de um guerreiro desde que ele tem memória, isolado do mundo e analfabeto, até conhecer uma mulher bonita que rouba seu coração. Ele se casa com ela e vive uma vida de folia, e ela fica grávida dos seus filhos. Inesperadamente, ela morre durante o parto, deixando o Noh apenas com seus trigêmeos recém-nascidos. Desesperado, triste, mas não quebrado, Noh proclama aos céus que ele se tornará um homem exemplar para criar os tesouros inestimáveis que sua esposa o deixou.  
  
Vamos testemunhar o guerreiro implacável Noh se tornando um pai incomparável, percebendo o quão poderoso ele pode ser pelo bem dos seus filhos.

История бесподобного отца, которому известна воля небес. Автор Но Гён Чхан широко известен по манхве Красная Буря, но если вам нужна другая причина для чтения, то это удивительная история приключений мастера боевых искусств, включающая свадьбу, заботы отца и битвы. Она во многом похожа на Красную Бурю: крутой мастер, главный герой, беспокоящийся о своей семье, трагическая предыстория. Обязательно к прочтению для каждого, кому понравилась Красная Буря.

description.pt-br:
Noh Gajang é um homem forte, dedicado e humilde, com muito respeito pelas artes marciais. Mas, após a morte de sua adorável esposa, esse capanga de aluguel só quer um emprego fácil que lhe permita ser um bom pai para seus três bebês. Ele fica até feliz em ficar de guarda e afastar lutadores amadores se isso significar que pode voltar para casa em segurança todas as noites.

Mas quando um culto assustador começa a roubar crianças da cidade, Gajang precisa encarar o desafio e descobrir seu verdadeiro potencial guerreiro.

description.en:
Ura baito, also known as a shady part-time job: a gray area job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life. Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are seeking a large sum of money for some reason. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.
___
This work may affect you physically and mentally. Read it at your own risk. We are not responsible for any damage to your health.
description.ja: 裏バイト。それは合法違法含むグレーゾーンの高額報酬アルバイト。その金は、あなたの命の値段。とある事情で大金を求める黒嶺ユメと白浜和美の2人は、軽い気持ちで裏バイトに手を染めていく――。

title.ja-ro: Anata wa Dare o Erabimashita ka

altTitles.ja: あなたは誰を選びましたか

description.en: Gaku is the son of former Japanese national volleyball star Kei Shishiya. Through middle school, he’s played as his team’s ace hitter, though part of him wonders if that’s a title he earned, or one he was simply given. One day, Kei meets Noboru, a generational volleyball talent with a monstrous spiking arm, and vows to turn him into the next national standout. In the wake of that choice, Gaku realizes he can’t play the style his father demands, but swears he’ll defeat both Kei and Noboru with a game that’s entirely his own.
description.ja: 獅子谷 岳は引退した元日本代表のエース・獅子谷 慧の息子であることから中学のクラブチームでエースを担っていたが自分にアタッカーが向いているのか疑問を感じていた。ある日、岳の練習を見に来た慧はアタッカーとしての類稀れな才能を持ったノボルと出会い、彼を日本一のバレー選手にすると宣言。親子は決別する。岳は自らアタッカーとしての限界を証明し、自分の切り拓いたバレーで、父親とノボルを倒すと誓う。

High school students Mayama and Sayama. They’re childhood friends and best friends—the two of them do everything together. But lately, it seems like Sayama has been getting a lot of attention…?

Inseparable Childhood Friends: Signs of Change in Their Everyday Lives

description.en: A short webcomic series detailing the misadventures between Ex Albio and Ars Almal. Compilation of webcomics by 筆たらず (@LLVPunQEFDXM7wI)) (No official name)

Demons exist and their power is beyond what humans can fathom. In fact they are so strong that humans do not stand a chance against them in a fight. The only thing strong enough to defeat a demon is another demon and it is through this logic that Ryo Asuka hatches the plan to have his good-hearted friend Akira Fudo possessed by a demon. If a person is of pure of heart then he might be able to control the demon that possesses him and thereby acquire power equal to a demon. After raising some hell in a club the plan works and Akira is possessed by the powerful demon known as Amon. Now Akira is mankind's sole champion of justice against the hidden demon menace that has plagued humanity since the dawn of time.

[Official English](https://sevenseasentertainment.com/series/devilman-the-classic-collection/)
description.vi: Fudo Akira là một cậu học sinh có bố mẹ làm việc ở nước ngoài, hiện đang tạm trú ở nhà Makimura. Akira là một cậu bé trầm lặng, kiểu người sẽ dành hết thời gian rảnh rỗi ở thư viện. Cậu có một cuộc sống yên bình với Miki, con gái lớn của gia đình Makimura; cho đến một ngày nọ, bọn họ vướng phải rắc rối với một đám đầu gấu. Người đến giải cứu hai người họ là bạn thân trước đây của Akira - Asuka Ryo. Chẳng một chút vui vẻ gì với cuộc hội ngộ này, Ryo đột ngột thú nhận một điều làm đảo lộn toàn bộ cuộc sống của Akira...
description.pt-br: Demônios existem e seu poder está além do que os humanos podem entender. Na verdade, eles são tão fortes que os humanos não têm chance contra eles em uma luta. A única coisa forte o suficiente para derrotar um demônio é outro demônio e é através dessa lógica que Ryo Asuka pensa em um plano para que seu amigo de bom coração, Akira Fudo, fosse possuído por um demônio. Se uma pessoa é pura de coração, então ele pode ser capaz de controlar o demônio que o possui e, assim, adquirir poder igual a um demônio. Depois de um incidente em um clube, o plano funciona e Akira é possuído pelo poderoso demônio conhecido como Amon. Agora, Akira é o único defensor da justiça da humanidade contra a ameaça oculta dos demônios que atormentam a humanidade desde o início dos tempos.

description.en: One day, Ochibi (5 years old) who lives in the slums suddenly remembers that she has been reincarnated from another world. Ochibi has the "Imagination Creation" skill, which allows her to create anything she imagines. She decides to start a business with the Japanese items she obtains with her "Imagination Creation" skill! A heartwarming story with a boy named "Onii" and a girl named "Nene" who aim to escape the slums!!
description.ja: ある日突然、自分が異世界から転生したことを思い出した、スラム暮らしのおチビ（5歳）。 おチビは、想像したものを作り出せる「想像創造」スキルを持っていた。 「想像創造」スキルで手に入れた日本のアイテムで、商売を始めることに！ 少年「おにぃ」と少女「ねぇね」とともに、スラム脱出を目指す、ハートフルストーリー!!

description.en: During the day, Imaizumi attends his classes like any dutiful student, only to return each evening to a home full of hotties! It seems his home has become the go-to hangout for the coolest gyarus in town. From endless gossip fests to snack binges to getting downright physical with his three new housemates, his once-quiet abode is now buzzing with non-stop energy and exciting escapades. Can Imaizumi keep up with the lively antics of his lusty gal pals?
description.id: Imaizumi-kun, seorang siswa SMA yang hidup sendiri karena suatu alasan. Dia memiliki rahasia yang tidak bisa diketahui oleh siapa pun. Yaitu tinggal bersama tiga gadis "Hamasaki", "Kurumizaka" dan "Sasaki" yang berada di kasta atas di sekolah.
description.ja: 訳があって一人暮らしをしている高校生・今泉くん。そんな彼には誰にも言えない秘密が。それは学園で上位カーストに位置するギャル「浜崎」「胡桃坂」「佐々木」の３人と一緒に暮らしていること――。一癖も二癖もあるギャルたちとただ遊んで、ただ駄弁り、ただ毎日のように体を重ねる日々。怠惰でエッチで自由な「青春」に今泉くんはどんどんハマっていき…！？
description.pt-br: Imaizumi é um estudante do ensino médio que mora sozinho por um motivo. Ele tem um segredo que não pode contar a ninguém: ele mora com três das mais bonitas garotas de sua escola, Hamasaki, Kurumizaka e Sasaki. Ele passa seus dias jogando, conversando e fazendo sexo com essas garotas, todas com uma ou duas peculiaridades. Com o passar do tempo, Imaizumi se torna cada vez mais viciado na “juventude” preguiçosa, travessa e livre…?

description.en:
Summer vacation in my third year of college. A stiflingly hot countryside home. A dark storehouse that must never be entered.
My grandmother keeps muttering the same thing over and over: ‘Mentori-sama is watching.’
But it’s fine because I have my big sister.
A chilling folk-horror tale of blood ties and buried customs begins.
description.ja:
大学三年の夏休み。じっとりと暑い田舎の家。決して立ち入ってはいけない暗い蔵。
祖母が繰り返すうわごと「めんとりさまは、見てるからね。」
でも大丈夫――だって、おれには""ねえさん""がいる。
血族に巣食う因習ホラー奇譚、開幕。

description.en: My childhood friend is also my girlfriend. A dream come true, right? Hell no. She insults me on a daily basis. She grinds my dignity into shreds and it takes a toll on my mental well-being. I can't take it anymore. So I'm left with no choice, I'm going to break up with her. In order to maintain my sanity, it's the only option.
description.ja: 「――わかった。じゃあもう別れよう」一個下の幼馴染であり、彼女の如月花火からモラハラを受け続けてきた高校生の俺・一ノ瀬颯馬も、ついに限界になり別れを決めた。これでもう、彼女の望む通りに生きる必要はなく、苦しめられることもなくなった。すると、俺の生活はいい意味で一変した。花火による呪縛も解け、クラスメイトとの楽しい毎日が始まったのである。そんな俺の隣の席に座る女の子・雪代史。大ぶりの眼鏡の印象が強く、他の生徒とはどこか違う雰囲気がある彼女との会話の中で、花火とは違って自然体でいられる自分に気づいた俺は、徐々に彼女が気になり始める。そうだ、まだ遅くはない。これから青春の学校生活を満喫していこう！
description.pt-br: Minha amiga de infância também é minha namorada. Um sonho realizado, certo? De jeito nenhum, ela me insulta diariamente, ela destrói minha dignidade e isso afeta meu bem-estar mental, não aguento mais. Então não tenho escolha, terminarei com ela. Para manter minha sanidade, é a única opção.

description.en:
The world of Srko is one full of sin and death. The nations of the Middle Lands fight for survival while the Scorch Crows, lead by Dioneese, slowly conquer their land as their own. The kings of the lands yet to be conquered fear that their kingdoms are next in line to be absorbed into the territories taken under the pressing grip of the crow’s talons.

The brother-in-law of Dioneese is a purple lizardman named Whacks Wangsworth. He’s short, very short, and isn’t the brightest. But when his wife is kidnapped by Dioneese, her own brother, Whacks sees to it that he leaves his two adopted daughters in search of his captive wife. One of these daughters, named Starlight, secretly follows him, and befriends a tall, otherworldly warrior named Lord D. These three unknowingly have found their spirits entangled in a cosmic plan so beyond their understanding that what they see in the physical realm, and what Lord D has seen in the spirit realm, doesn’t even show a sliver of a fraction of what they are about to experience. Death, kingdoms against kingdoms, war, famine, and the ever-present weight of the stench of absolute depravity tainting every thought, word, and deed of every mortal on the surfaces of the three layers of creation. This inability to do good, this absolute depravity that stains the spirits of every mortal being from the time of their conception, is unknown to most. Those who do know of its presence think of it in various ways. For some, such as Lord D, it’s an inevitability, a dark and depressing truth of the world they live in. For others, like Whacks, it is a passive truth, but true nonetheless; something to be apathetic towards as long as a goal is in mind. But for some, like Starlight, the weight is greater than anything in creation. Yet they know of a hope to come, a divine truth that contrasts the stain of this inherited sin, that makes the ugly form of absolute depravity seem as nothing in comparison.

Alas, this hope is forgotten to time, only remembered by a select few. But to those who do know of this hope, they know the truth…

The day of sacrifice is near.
The story of creation is nearing its end.

altTitles.th: หาญสู้พลิกชะตาอาถรรพณ์

description.en:
Onmyoji and Yokai? A girl's bizarre Taisho romance! When she was in the first grade of elementary school, her whole family was involved in an accident, but she is the only one who survived. In her third year of junior high school, she passes by the accident site again and is somehow transported back to the Taisho Era! The next day, Nanoka's physical abilities are awakened when she is told by Mao, a boy she met there who is an Onmyoji, "You are a demon, aren't you?"
___
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by [Elex Media](https://www.gramedia.com/products/mao-01) (2021)
description.ja: 小学一年生の時、一家全員が事故に巻き込まれるも自分だけ生き残った過去を持つ黄葉菜花。中学三年になった彼女が再び事故現場を通るとなぜか大正時代へ！そこで出会った陰陽師の少年・摩緒より「お前、妖だろう」と言われた翌日に菜花の身体能力が覚醒した――自身の「謎」を解き明かすため、菜花は摩緒と行動を共にする事になるが…

description.en: It's the 21st century, and the number of ESPers continues to increase. They are active in the military, diplomacy, politics, and in other places. They hold the key for global competition. A country that controls ESP can control the world! However individuals who posses higher than Level 4 are less than 3% of the population. There are only three Level 7 people who have government contracts. These three are Kaoru, Aoi, and Shiho, ten-year old girls, who work for B.A.B.E.L. With the guidance of Kouichi, a twenty-year old genius, they catch criminals and evil ESPers.
description.pl: W przyszłości ludzie posiadające zdolności ESP pojawiają się coraz częściej. W większości są to osoby ze zdolnościami na tyle słabymi, że nie wpływa to na ich codzienne życie. Jednak pojawiają się również wyjątki w postaci jednostek z potężniejszymi umiejętnościami. Na świecie osób mających poziom siódmy jest wyłącznie kilkoro, a w samej Japonii znajduje się ich trójka. Japoński rząd zatrudnił do współpracy z B.A.B.E.L. właśnie tę trójkę najpotężniejszych ESPerów. Okazały się nimi trzy dziesięcioletnie dziewczynki: Kaoru, Aoi i Shiho. Co może spotkać rozbrykane małolaty i ich starszego opiekuna, Kouichi Minamoto? Dowiedzcie się sami…

altTitles.ja: デカいうさぎに懐かれた！？

altTitles.en: A Big Rabbit has Taken a Liking to Me!?
I Got Tamed by a Giant Rabbit!?

altTitles.bn: একটা বড় খরগোশ আমাকে পছন্দ করেছে!?

altTitles.pt-br: Uma coelha gigante tá gostando de mim!?

description.en: A new member of the workforce, the night before his first day... Hajime Ogami is so nervous he can’t sleep. Plagued by anxiety over whether he can make it in the distant, unfamiliar city of Fukuoka, Hajime heads out for a midnight stroll. There, he is accosted by a strangely over-familiar, "giant" drunk woman, and the two of them end up heading out into the "city at night" together...!?
description.ja: 新社会人、勤務開始前日…大神ハジメは緊張して眠れずにいた。遠く慣れない福岡の地でうまくやっていけるのか…不安に苛まれた末に夜の散歩に出かけたハジメは、妙に馴れ馴れしい“デッカい”酔っ払いの女の人に絡まれ、“二人で夜の街”に繰り出すことになり…！？
description.pt-br: Um novo membro da força de trabalho, na noite antes do seu primeiro dia... Hajime Ogami está tão nervoso que não consegue dormir. Atormentado pela ansiedade sobre se conseguirá chegar à distante e desconhecida cidade de Fukuoka, Hajime sai para um passeio à meia-noite. Lá, ele é abordado por uma mulher estranhamente familiar, "gigante" e bêbada, e os dois acabam indo juntos para a "cidade à noite"...!? Ambientada em Hakata, esta história de cortar o coração que retrata o "relacionamento próximo" entre um homem e uma mulher adultos começa agora!!

description.en: Four mischievous girls illegally occupy the former Traditional Tea Ceremony clubroom, in order to create the "Amusement Club." These scamps…who ignore repeated warnings—in direct rebellion with the righteous directives of the Student Council—decide to remain in the room until they finally get off their bums and do something! In this slightly sluggish manga, full of fits and starts, the four girls set off from their homes for a walk together with days full of a little this and that!
description.ja: 旧・茶道部の部室を不法占拠して勝手に「ごらくぶ」の活動を続ける、悪の4人組。正義の生徒会は、ならず者どもを一掃するためについに重い腰を上げたのだった…という展開ははっきり言って全くない、まったりコミック第1巻が登場。愛が溢れまくりで、明日からも元気に生きて行けること請け合い。よ～し、パパ二度寝しちゃうぞ～!!
description.vi:
-  Note: Tuy có tag Yuri nhưng truyện rất hài cốt, ai từng xem anime chắc cũng biết!
 -  Tóm Tắt: Bốn cô gái nghịch ngợm đã “chiếm dụng” lại phòng câu lạc bộ Trà đạo cũ để lập ra "Câu lạc bộ Giải trí" – một nơi không có mục đích cụ thể, chỉ để tụ họp và vui chơi. Dù đã bị Hội học sinh nhiều lần nhắc nhở, họ vẫn cứ ung dung ở lại, không màng luật lệ. Trong bộ truyện nhẹ nhàng, hài hước này, bốn cô bé tinh ranh mãnh này sẽ cùng nhau trải qua những ngày thường nhật với đủ thứ chuyện linh tinh, dễ thương và đầy tiếng cười!
description.pt-br: Quatro garotas travessas ocupam ilegalmente a antiga sala do clube da Cerimônia Tradicional do Chá para criar o "Clube de Diversão". Essas atentadas... que ignoram repetidos avisos - em rebelião direta às justas diretrizes do Conselho Estudantil - decidem permanecer na sala até que finalmente se levantem e façam alguma coisa! Neste mangá um pouco lento, como o título sugere, cheio de trancos e barrancos, as quatro meninas saem de suas casas para passear juntas, com dias cheios dum pouco disso e daquilo!

altTitles.th: สัตว์มหัศจรรย์
มีสัตว์ป่าว

description.en:
"In this realm mythological creatures roam, descendant of the nine heavens they call home." 

Sibuxiang, a mythical deer-man couch potato, is kicked out of heaven and assigned to support the mythological creatures wandering the human world. He meets and goes on adventures with his friends: the energetic, food loving Pixiu named Pipi, the fanatic moon bunny Tuye, the banished-from-heaven mouse brothers Jinjiao and Yinjiao, and many others. What kind of adventures will they take on?
description.th:
[ เทพอสูรท่องมนุษย์ ดั้นเมฆามาจากเก้าชั้นฟ้า ]

ยุคสมัยที่เทคโนโลยีก้าวหน้า ยุคทองของเหล่าเทพอสูรผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ในอดีตก็จบลง วันเวลาผ่านไปยิ่งอยู่อย่างกะโหลกกะลา 

“ซื่อปู้เซียง” เทพอสูรสายลุย ได้รับบัญชาให้ลงมายังโลกมนุษย์ เพื่อตามหาและช่วยเหลือเหล่าเพื่อนพ้องเทพอสูรที่ตกอับกระจัดกระจายอยู่บนโลก

พอมาถึงโลกมนุษย์ เขาก็ได้พบกับ “เทียนลู่” อดีตเพื่อนร่วมงานที่กำลังจนตรอกไร้ทางไป, “ทู่เย่” คอสุราสุดแป้กที่ชีวิตไม่เคยได้ดี 

และสองพี่น้องหยินเจียวจินเจียวที่โดนเนรเทศลงมาจากสวรรค์…

และแล้ว การเดินทางบทใหม่ของพวกเขาก็ได้เริ่มต้นขึ้น!
description.zh:
《人间有神兽，来自九重天 》

随着科技的发展，往日威风凛凛的神兽们日子大不如前。神兽四不像奉命下凡，去解救流落人间的落魄神兽。在凡间，他遇到了走投无路的老同事天禄，不得志的酒友兔爷，被贬下凡的金银角兄弟……从此开启了一段新的旅程。
description.es-la:
"En este reino, criaturas mitológicas deambulan, descendientes de los nueve cielos que llaman hogar."
Sibuxiang, un hombre-ciervo mitológico y perezoso, es expulsado del cielo y asignado a apoyar a las criaturas mitológicas que vagan por el mundo humano. Conoce y vive aventuras con sus amigos: el enérgico Pixiu amante de la comida llamado Pipi, el fanático conejo lunar Tony, los hermanos ratones Jinjiao y Yinjiao, también desterrados del cielo, y muchos otros. ¿Qué tipo de aventuras emprenderán?
description.pt-br:
"Neste reino, criaturas mitológicas vagam, descendentes dos nove céus que chamam de lar.”

Sibuxiang, um mítico homem-cervo preguiçoso, é expulso do céu e recebe a missão de ajudar as criaturas mitológicas que vagam pelo mundo humano. Ele conhece e vive aventuras com seus amigos: o energético e faminto Pixiu chamado Pipi, o fanático coelho da Lua, Tuye, os irmãos ratos banidos do céu Jinjiao e Yinjiao, e muitos outros. Que tipo de aventuras eles viverão?

description.en:
Nobody on the continent hasn't heard of the evil deeds of the great outlaw M. Godspeed. But one day, a young man claiming to be the criminal's son suddenly appears trekking through the harsh desert. This Jim Godspeed says he's killed his father and has the corpse to prove it!

(Source: MangaPlus)
description.es:
M. Godspeed fue un legendario villano cuya crueldad extrema hizo que su nombre resonara por todo el continente.
Un día, apareció un joven llamado Jim Godspeed, quien afirmó ser su hijo.
Jim dijo haber matado a su padre con sus propias manos y haber cruzado el desierto ¡con su cadáver a cuestas...!
¡Disfruta de esta épica historia ambientada en el Oeste de mano del aclamado maestro Boichi!

(Fuente: MangaPlus)
description.ja: 無法者（デスペラード）たちが暴れ回る荒廃した時代――。無敵の悪党M・ゴッドスピードの棺を引き摺り、独り砂漠をゆく男がいた。彼の名は“M”の息子、ジム・ゴッドスピード。ジムは自らの手で殺した父の亡骸を手土産に、保安官になると宣言するが…！？大悪党の息子が心に宿すのは、正義か悪か。
description.vi:
Không ai trên khắp vùng đất này là chưa từng nghe đến những hành động tàn ác của tên tội phạm khét tiếng M. Godspeed.

Nhưng một ngày nọ, một chàng trai trẻ tuổi tự xưng là con trai của tên tội phạm đột nhiên xuất hiện, lặn lội qua vùng sa mạc khắc nghiệt.

Jim Godspeed này nói rằng hắn đã giết cha mình và có xác chết để chứng minh điều đó!

Một câu chuyện miền viễn tây theo phong cách steampunk đến từ Boichi!
description.pt-br:
Ninguém no continente desconhece os atos malignos do grande fora da lei M. Godspeed.

Mas um dia, um jovem que afirma ser filho do criminoso surge repentinamente, atravessando o árido deserto.

Esse jovem, Jim Godspeed, diz ter matado seu pai – e tem o cadáver para provar!

Um western steampunk vindo da mente do mestre, Boichi!

title.ja-ro: Douka Ore o Houtte Oitekure: Nazeka Bocchi no Owatta Koukou Seikatsu o Kanojo ga Kaeyou to shitekuru

altTitles.ja: どうか俺を放っておいてくれ　なぜかぼっちの終わった高校生活を彼女が変えようとしてくる

altTitles.en: Let Me Be Single in Peace!

description.en:
Love, friendship, and a glorious adolescence—that's what Hodoka Nanamura hoped for when he entered high school. But by his final year, he had none of it. Then, on the eve of graduation, he sacrifices himself to save his classmate, Sora Hanamitsuji, from on oncoming truck, ending his life... or so it should have. Instead, he and Hanamitsuji were both transported back in time to their first year of high school, just before the entrance ceremony. Though Nanamura resigned himself to reliving the same unremarkable, lonely high school years, Hanamitsuji swears that she'll drag him out of his loner lifestyle!

*Source: Manga UP! Global*
description.ja: 恋、友情、輝かしい青春。そんな期待に胸を膨らませた俺の高校生活は――結局ぼっちのまま終わった。そして迎えた卒業式前日。クラスメイトの花見辻空をかばい、俺はトラックに轢かれて人生の幕を閉じた……はずだった。花見辻と一緒に高校一年生の入学式に戻ってしまった俺。二度目の高校生活は輝かしい青春など期待せず大人しくぼっちで過ごそうと思いきや……。「ぼっち脱却、私が手伝ってあげる」
